name: Cape Greco
description: The southeast corner of the island: white cliffs, sea caves you can swim into, and a natural rock arch at Kamara tou Koraka. It's a national forest park, so the hotel wall stops dead at the boundary and the coast carries on.
getting: Cycle or walk the coastal path from Ayia Napa, about an hour. Bus 101/102 runs along the top. Sunrise is the point — this is the first place in Cyprus the sun hits.
